items.summary: FPMPAM calls for meaningful reform, better use of existing health care resources, and renewed confidence in the medical profession. The post Malaysia Needs A Paradigm Shift In Health Care, Not Just A Bigger Budget — FPMPAM appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.summary: When Malaysia grows old, the measure of its health policy will not be how many diseases it detects, but how many people it helps stay on their feet. The post Budget 2027 Can Detect NCDs. Who Is Paid To Prevent Them? — Muhammad Hafeez Basri appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Objection To Naming Food Technologists As Authorised Officers Under The Food Act 1983 — MyEnvHeat
items.summary: MyEnvHeat opposes a proposal in the Food (Amendment) Bill 2026 to name food technologists (PTM) as authorised enforcement officers, saying this may create a conflict of interest because PTM currently provide guidance and advisory services to industry. The post Objection To Naming Food Technologists As Authorised Officers Under The Food Act 1983 — MyEnvHeat appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: After Pharmacists, Contract Dentists Also Demand Permanent Posts
items.summary: After pharmacists demand permanent posts following Budget 2027 that provided 9,000 permanent positions for doctors, a dental group says contract dentists shouldn't be left behind either. Contracts of the 2021 dentists' cohort expired without extension. The post After Pharmacists, Contract Dentists Also Demand Permanent Posts appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Budget 2027: Permanent Posts Are Progress, Retention Remains Unresolved — Specialist
items.summary: MOH must clarify if the contract doctor system is indeed "abolished", as perceived by many, by stating if housemen entering in 2027 will begin as permanent employees or receive guaranteed conversion, besides eligibility for other existing MO cohorts. The post Budget 2027: Permanent Posts Are Progress, Retention Remains Unresolved — Specialist appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Sabah Loses Over 240 Doctors, 64% No-Shows Among Postings From Outside Sabah
items.summary: Sabah lost 244 medical officers, mostly in hospitals, because 333 transferred out of the state for permanent posts, but only 89 from outside Sabah reported for duty in that state. Among 269 MOs from outside posted to Sabah, there were 171 no-shows (64%). The post Sabah Loses Over 240 Doctors, 64% No-Shows Among Postings From Outside Sabah appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Budget 2027 Omits NCD Control, Health Workforce Reforms
items.summary: The Galen Centre says regularising existing doctors with permanent positions doesn't increase the actual number of HCPs. Budget 2027 omitted a multi-year recruitment and retention programme. Sugar subsidies were kept, while tobacco taxes weren't raised. The post Budget 2027 Omits NCD Control, Health Workforce Reforms appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Ending Contract Doctor System Welcomed, But Health Workforce Retention Needed — MMA
items.summary: Abolishing the contract doctor system is a significant milestone, but Budget 2027 should have introduced a comprehensive health workforce retention strategy, including specialist doctors, says MMA. The revised RM100 FDS incentive remains inadequate. The post Ending Contract Doctor System Welcomed, But Health Workforce Retention Needed — MMA appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Government Abolishes Madani Medical Scheme Under Budget 2027
items.summary: After three over years, the government has abolished Skim Perubatan Madani despite its popularity, as the programme subsidising acute care at private GP clinics wasn't listed in MOH's 2027 budget. Funding for Peka B40, MHTC, and NCEMH remained stagnant. The post Government Abolishes Madani Medical Scheme Under Budget 2027 appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Budget 2027: ProtectHealth Welcomes RM280m For Health Screening, Hospital Outsourcing
items.summary: The allocations will support ProtectHealth’s continuing role in expanding access to care across both preventive and hospital services. The post Budget 2027: ProtectHealth Welcomes RM280m For Health Screening, Hospital Outsourcing appeared first on CodeBlue .
